meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 你把本地附件的路径给它,Claude 就在容器内用 anydoc 命令把 Word、表格、演示文稿、PDF 等转成 Markdown,存到输出目录并告诉你文件路径。转换全程在本地完成,不上传外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当消息里给出了本地附件路径、需要读取它又不想上传到外部解析器时触发,涵盖 Word、PDF、CSV 等格式。

say.text: 这份表格的百分比和隐藏行可能丢,别拿它做数值计算
转换失败的话,说清是不支持、加密还是内容损坏
say.note: 按原文列出的失败类型回报

howto.what_en: Claude takes the local attachment path you give it and runs the AnyDoc CLI inside the agent container to turn Word, spreadsheet, presentation, PDF and similar files into local Markdown, then returns the output file path. Nothing is uploaded to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser. Covers office files, CSV and text-based PDFs.

say_en.note: Writes an .md in the container and returns its path

say_en.text: Percentages and hidden rows may be lost, don't do math off it
say_en.note: Treat the Markdown as reading context only

say_en.text: If conversion fails, say if it's unsupported, encrypted or malformed
say_en.note: Reports the failure types listed in the skill
